title: Native JavaScript dispatch site file v1
description: Researcher-supplied armed sites for the native JavaScript dispatch probe, written by the analyzer from static interpreter-candidate sites. The file must also be exact compact canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace, no trailing newline) of at most 4096 bytes, each (source_sha256, anchor_offset) pair must be unique, and anchor_offset must be below source_length. Those rules are outside JSON Schema and are checked by every reader. Matching uses only source_sha256, source_length, anchor_offset and shape; artifact_id, artifact_sha256 and byte_offset record provenance. See native-js-dispatch-v1.md.

anchor_offset.description: UTF-16 code-unit offset of the switch keyword or of the [ that opens the callee's computed member, in the decoded script text.

artifact_id.description: Captured JavaScript artifact that holds the static site. Provenance only.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw artifact bytes. Provenance only.

byte_offset.description: UTF-8 location.byte_offset of the static site in the artifact. Provenance only.

source_length.description: Length of the decoded script text in UTF-16 code units.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the decoded script text (strict UTF-8, one leading U+FEFF removed) encoded as UTF-16LE code units.
